items.source:
These properties allow configuration of multiple named Streamable Http connections to
MCP servers. Each connection is configured with a URL endpoint for communication.
items.translation: 这些属性允许配置多个命名流式 HTTP 连接至 MCP 服务器。每个连接均配置有用于通信的 URL 端点。

items.source: Parameters for configuring an Streamable Http connection to an MCP server.
items.translation: 配置用于与 MCP 服务器建立可流式 HTTP 连接的参数。

items.source: map of connection names to their Streamable Http parameters
items.translation: 连接名称到其可流式 HTTP 参数的映射图

items.source: Configuration properties for Streamable Http client connections.
items.translation: 流式 HTTP 客户端连接的配置属性。

items.source:
spring.ai.mcp.client.streamable-http:
  connections:
    server1:
      url: http://localhost:8080/events
    server2:
      url: http://otherserver:8081/events
items.translation:
